title: tpm2-tools 2a follow-ups, lower priority: remedy from effective groups, checker holes, start readers before stdin, spawn errors as Tpm2Error (#301 round 2 new 3, 6, 9, 10)
description: Lower-ranked follow-ups from the #301 round 2 APPROVE. New 3: accessRemedy should compare the device gid and mode with process.getgroups(): DAC already grants access means a security policy (for example AppArmor) refused it; the group lists the user but the process lacks it means start a new login. New 6: the no-fallback checker allows ./sqlite-vault-store.ts without a name check, matches only the import-braces form, and misses Bun.file(p).writer(), keyctl through Bun.spawn, dynamic import() and require(); restrict, flag every other import form and extend the control. New 9: start both readCapped readers before writing stdin so a tool that fills stdout first is reported as tool_output_too_large, not tool_timeout. New 10: wrap Bun.spawn in spawnTool so a tool removed after detection raises a Tpm2Error (tool_failed or tools_absent), not a raw Error.

acceptanceCriteria.text: accessRemedy distinguishes an already-granted-by-DAC refusal and a stale-session group from a missing group, each with a test
The no-fallback checker covers every import form, the allowed ward module by name, Bun.file writer, keyctl, import() and require(), with a control for each
A tool that fills stdout before reading stdin is refused as tool_output_too_large, and a spawn failure raises a Tpm2Error
